children: The Trump-Xi summit is expected to be heavier on optics than substance, without any macro-moving developments, Barclays Research says in a note. China is expected to push for further tariff relief and argue against the "overcapacity" tariff, it says. China could also press for looser U.S. tech restrictions. Meanwhile, China is likely to offer some concessions on rare earths and a constructive role in issues like the U.S.-Iran conflict, the note adds. (monica.gupta@wsj.com)
